candidatePlan.selectionMethod: Explicit finite fractional px-per-point grid from 2.0 to 2.5 in 0.1 increments. Observed width/height native estimates cluster around 2.0, 2.2, 2.3 and 2.4; 2.2 is independently calibrated by the exact MM p.54/p.80 replay report. The grid is bounded and is not claimed exhaustive.
candidatePlan.sourceClipMethod: Read the frozen normalizedPageRect and map it directly through the canonical PDF Page.rect; render the actual source crop at the tested Matrix(scale, scale), with alpha=False and annots=False.
candidatePlan.acceptanceRule: Exact RGB pixel equality and exact dimensions are required for a positive. When RGB pixels match, encode the crop as PNG and compare the file SHA/bytes to the public catalog image. No resize, padding, approximate pixel metric, or bounds-only match counts as positive.

manualSourceFrameReview.inspectionMode: Each actual PDF-derived positive crop was opened in a separate image result; no composites or OCR-only review were used.
manualSourceFrameReview.assessment: All listed crops visually correspond to their direct canonical-PDF crop render; this agrees with exact RGB and PNG byte identity. This is only a source-frame replay assessment.
